{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Count unique patients (this includes those with biomarker_baseline == -999)
unique_patient_count = len(data_dedup)
print(unique_patient_count)"}
